sentences.en: In these statistics Egypt is classed as an African nation.
sentences.zh: 在这些统计数据中，埃及被列为非洲国家。

sentences.en: My father is from South Africa. He is South African.
sentences.zh: 我父亲来自南非。他是南非人。

sentences.en: The African elephant has bigger ears than the Asian elephant.
sentences.zh: 非洲象的耳朵比亚洲象的大。
